title: Switching astronaut chem lights from red to green

tellings.quote: it took me a year and a half to to get NASA to switch to the green chem lights.

plain: Between about 1989 and 1991 at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, a NASA doctor named Greg Rogers says he pushed the agency to change the chemical light sticks used for astronauts from red to green, and that it took him 'a year and a half' to get NASA to make the switch. He tells Michels this from his own work there, naming a Colonel Shokitis as part of the story.
